overviews.title: What is Lifestyle Accessory Design? Courses, Fees, Top Institutes, Careers & Salary 2025

blocks.value: Lifestyle Accessory Design means designing accessories using various materials and techniques that resonate with humans and their geographical contexts. Lifestyle Accessory Design includes various domains like Jewellery Design, Interior Design, Footwear Design, and so on.

Lifestyle Accessory Design courses are intended to teach students to visualize and create lifestyle accessories and systems using different materials, processes, and technologies. These courses are offered at the UG, PG, Diploma, and Certificate levels.

Some popular Lifestyle Accessory Design programs include BDes in Accessory Design, Certificate in Design in Boutique Apparel and Accessory, BSc in Fashion and Lifestyle Technology, MDes in Fashion Styling, Master Diploma in Jewelry Retail Technology, etc.

The eligibility criteria for Lifestyle Accessory Design courses may vary depending on the course level; however, the minimum requirement is to pass Class 12 from any stream (Arts, Science, or Commerce) from a recognized board. NIFT Entrance, GAT, CAT, NID Entrance , Pearl Academy Entrance, UCEED, CUET, etc., are some popular entrance exams conducted for Lifestyle Accessory Design admissions .

Some popular colleges in India offering Lifestyle Accessory Design courses include NIFT Delhi, Amity University, NIFT Bangalore, Pearl Academy, JD Institute of Fashion Technology, etc., with an average course fee ranging from INR 11,000 to INR 26.8 Lakh for UG-level and INR 2.74 Lakh to INR 11.85 Lakh for PG-level programs.

faqs.question: Which one is better between fashion design and lifestyle accessory design?
faqs.answer: Fashion Design deals with fabrics and what you can do with fabrics. You use fashion accessories for styling your garments but your main material of use is fabric. A lifestyle accessory designer however deals with all kind of materials ranging from paper to wood, metal, gems, leather, fabric, plastics, rubber and so on. The range of products that they can get into is huge. Accessory design is actually a subset of product design and hence is very different from fashion. As to which is better is difficult to say. Both have huge scope. Choice will actually depend on your temperament and aptitude. Sometimes you are not sure however. That's why at would we allow you to switch between courses after your foundation year.

faqs.question: Who can study a Lifestyle Accessory Design course?
faqs.answer: To have a future in this sector, one must have an artistic and creative nature in addition to the necessary educational qualifications. In order to pursue Designing courses , aspirants must also be competent at drawing and have the capacity to explain their thoughts utilising helpful sketches. Candidates who are hardworking and creative, with a flair for design and great sketching and drawing skills, can pursue Accessory Design courses . They must be able to conceptualise and sketch their concepts in a short period of time. They must be selective in their fabric selection and possess marketing and communication abilities in order to oversee the manufacture of diverse commodities. They must be detail-oriented and able to demonstrate their abilities.

faqs.question: Who is a Lifestyle Accessory Designer?
faqs.answer: A Lifestyle Accessory Designer creates ornaments and accessories to go with a certain clothing. An accessory designer, like a fashion designer, is extremely inventive. Candidates for the job of accessory designer must have an artistic enthusiasm and a desire to express themselves through their work. A career as an Accessory Designer can be extremely lucrative because India's fashion sector is expected to be the sixth the largest in the world by 2023, generating job prospects for applicants with fashion designer degrees. There are numerous universities in India that offer Lifestyle Accessory Designer courses, including the National Institute of Fashion Technology in New Delhi, the National Institute of Design in Ahmedabad, and the Pearl Academy in New Delhi.

faqs.question: What are the careers after Lifestyle Accessory Design?
faqs.answer: Lifestyle accessories covers every product that you use on your person or in your personal space. It can relate to fashion, such as scarves, ties, shades, jewelry, belts, shoes, wallets, purses, bags, luggage, table-top accessories, car interior products, phone accessories, lab-top accessories, decorative items, etc. The list is endless and so is the scope.

faqs.question: What are the job opportunities after a Certificate in lifestyle accessory design?
faqs.answer:
A Certificate in Lifestyle Accessory Design focuses on skill training in designing fashion accessories. You can get the following jobs based on your skills and experience with a Certificate in lifestyle accessory design:
1. Jewelry Designer: This profession pays an average annual salary of Rs. 3.4 Lacs. With six to seven years of experience, you could earn up to Rs. 8 Lacs if you get a job in a top jewelry company. 
2. Accessory Designer: You can work as a designer for stylistic accessories like bracelets. With one to two years of experience in a good company, you can earn around Rs. 3.4 Lacs in this job. 
3. Leather Designer: Your work will include designing leather lifestyle products such as purses. You can earn around 4 LPA in this profession. 
4. Footwear designer: If you specialize in designing footwear, you can work as a footwear designer. In a good company, you can earn around Rs. 3.5 Lacs per year. Other than these you can get jobs like lifestyle accessory designer for handbags, belts, hats, scarves, etc.
